name: Spawn
summary: Adds /trigger spawn, which teleports you to the world spawn area with no cost and no default cooldown.

mechanics.title: Teleport
mechanics.description: /trigger spawn prints 'Teleporting to world spawn...' and teleports you after the configured delay (default 0 ticks), placing you at the first safe spot (the pack moves up out of solid blocks and down to the ground). Your previous position is saved for /trigger back.

mechanics.title: Delay and cooldown
mechanics.description: Operator-set: delay (ticks standing still, default 0) and cooldown (seconds between uses, default 0). Messages: 'Your Spawn cooldown will end in N seconds.' and 'You must stand still to teleport.'

getting_started: Type /trigger spawn anywhere. Use /trigger back to return.
editor_notes: The teleport target is computed from the position the tick function runs at (world origin X 0.5 / Z 0.5, Overworld), then adjusted for safe height, rather than reading the actual world spawn point. Verify in-game that it matches spawn, and whether it works from the Nether/End (probably teleports to the Overworld).
